as_told.title: Truman-Forrestal memo and first NSC meeting

plain: The claim is that the Majestic 12 papers, a set of documents describing a secret panel said to have handled crashed saucers, give dates for meetings between President Harry Truman and his Defense Secretary James Forrestal that match the days the two men really met. A researcher who goes by UAPGerb makes the point in passing, tying it to the Eisenhower briefing document, one of these papers presented as a briefing for President Eisenhower. Michels tells it in more detail himself. He describes a memo from Truman to Forrestal dated 24 September 1947, and he brings in the government scientist Vannevar Bush, the first meeting of the National Security Council, the president's top security body, and the UFO researcher Stanton Friedman. Both tell it for the same reason: if the dates line up, whoever wrote the papers knew the real schedules of the men at the top. The two tellers do not give the same detail, with Michels alone naming the September 1947 memo.
